name: Chemistry for Human Health: Principles and Applications
description: Introduction to human physiology and pharmacology: historical overview, systems approach to physiology, homeostasis (mass balance approach), membrane transport receptor theory, drug delivery, routes of administration, dose-response relationship (AUC and Cmax), pharmacokinetics (ADME: oral versus systemic). Chemistry of materials for healthcare: introduction to biocompatibility and biodegradability, structure- property relationships in materials, introduction to DDS, controlled-release and polymeric drug delivery. Chemical factories in human body: introduction to human microbiome, dysbiosis; pre and probiotics, gut microbiome and introduction to omics.
